platformSummary: Windows and Linux are supported. Release 1.3.13 passes installation and process gates on both; Windows Chromium component acceptance passes with the unchanged 1.3.12 adapter.
extensionSummary: The Chrome Web Store serves Chrome adapter v1.3.12, compatible with service 1.3.13. The existing injector loads the installed service runtime without an extension update or reload. Compatibility is recorded in compatibility.json.
